page.overview:
Who is Ghattambah?

Ghattambah, the Insect-God, is a fictional entity created by Mark McLaughlin with input from Michael Sheehan, Jr. for the Cthulhu Mythos humor and bawdy tales collection Best Little Witch-House in Arkham.

Ghattambah exists outside of time and space, and is said to be able to gift those it deems worthy with fantastic powers.

The High Priest of Ghattambah's human cult, Azmael Mondrago, has shown no compunction in destroying those who trespass within its chapel, and is suspected of being responsible for the disappearance of several children in his time, suggesting that Ghattambah requires blood sacrifice (: "In The Chapel Of Ghattambah").

At some point in Earth's future Ghattambah served Nyarlathotep in the Outer God's plots to lay waste to the human race. (: "The Spawn Of Ghattambah").
